title: Unit 5 第四课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: I. 语音练习，根据音标写单词
sections.instruction: 根据所给音标和上下文提示，写出正确的单词。

questions.prompt: Are you ______ ['ɪntrəstɪd] in musical instruments?
questions.translation: 你对乐器感兴趣吗？
questions.explanation: 根据音标 ['ɪntrəstɪd] 和固定搭配 be interested in 可知，此处填 interested。

questions.prompt: We are looking for new members who can: • play the ______ ['ɪnstrəmənts]
questions.translation: 我们正在寻找能够演奏乐器的新成员……
questions.explanation: 根据音标 ['ɪnstrəmənts] 及前文 musical 可知，此处填 instruments 的复数形式。

questions.prompt: • play the ______ [drʌmz]
questions.translation: • 打鼓
questions.explanation: 根据音标 [drʌmz] 可知，此处填名词 drum 的复数形式 drums。

questions.prompt: • sing with ______ ['fiːlɪŋ]
questions.translation: • 带感情地歌唱
questions.explanation: 根据音标 ['fiːlɪŋ] 可知，此处填名词 feeling。

questions.prompt: Where: Music ______ [klʌb]
questions.translation: 地点：音乐俱乐部
questions.explanation: 根据音标 [klʌb] 可知，此处填名词 club。

sections.title: II. 连词成句
sections.instruction: 连词成句，注意标点符号。

questions.prompt: you, with, well, hands, your, work, can (?)
questions.answer: Can you work well with your hands?
questions.translation: 你能用双手灵巧地工作吗？
questions.explanation: 根据标点 (?) 及词汇提示，组词成一般疑问句：Can you work well with your hands?

questions.prompt: soon, can, for, your, you, cook, family (.)
questions.answer: You can soon cook for your family.
questions.translation: 你不久就能为你的家人做饭了。
questions.explanation: 根据标点 (.) 及词汇提示，组词成陈述句：You can soon cook for your family.

questions.prompt: after, come, the, library, to, Tuesday, on, school (.)
questions.answer: Come to the library on Tuesday after school.
questions.translation: 周二放学后到图书馆来。
questions.explanation: 根据标点 (.) 及词汇提示，组词成祈使句：Come to the library on Tuesday after school.

questions.prompt: wildlife, under, discover, right, nose, your (!)
questions.answer: Discover wildlife right under your nose!
questions.translation: 发现就在你眼皮底下的野生动物！
questions.explanation: 根据标点 (!) 及词汇提示，组词成祈使句：Discover wildlife right under your nose!

questions.prompt: wants, our, start, school, to, music, a, club (.)
questions.answer: Our school wants to start a music club.
questions.translation: 我们学校想创办一个音乐俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 根据标点 (.) 及词汇提示，组词成陈述句：Our school wants to start a music club.

sections.title: III. 词形转换
sections.instruction: 写出下列单词的相应形式。

questions.translation: want 的第三人称单数形式是 wants。
questions.explanation: 动词 want 的第三人称单数形式直接加 s，即 wants。

questions.prompt: 2. tell (动名词) ______
questions.translation: tell 的动名词形式是 telling。
questions.explanation: 动词 tell 的动名词形式为 telling。

questions.translation: we 的宾格形式是 us。
questions.explanation: 人称代词主格 we 的宾格形式是 us。

questions.prompt: 4. live (形容词) ______
questions.translation: live 的形容词形式是 alive。
questions.explanation: 动词 live 对应的形容词为 alive（活着的）或 lively（生动的）。在此处常见转换中填 alive 或 lively，标准答案常为 alive。

questions.translation: feel 的名词形式是 feeling。
questions.explanation: 动词 feel 的名词形式为 feeling（感觉）。

questions.prompt: 6. Wednesday (复数) ______
questions.translation: Wednesday 的复数形式是 Wednesdays。
questions.explanation: 专有名词 Wednesday 表示星期三，其复数形式可以直接加 s 表示“每周三”。

sections.title: IV. 完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
What do you do after class at your school? You may (可能) [1] you go home and do [2] homework. Besides, I think you can have [3] other things to do.

You can [4] different clubs. If you are good at [5], you can be at the swimming club. Maybe you can't play the piano [6] the drums very well, but you can [7] to play them in the music club. I like [8] and I often go to the reading club. My friend can [9] well and she goes to the art club two times a week. Do you like painting? You can learn [10] her.

questions.prompt: 1. 选出空白处①的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 你可能会说你回家写作业。
questions.explanation: 根据句意“你可能会说……”，say 侧重于说具体的内容，故选 say。

questions.prompt: 2. 选出空白处②的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 做你的作业。
questions.explanation: 主语是 you，因此作业应用形容词性物主代词 your，故选 your。

questions.prompt: 3. 选出空白处③的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 有许多其他的事情要做。
questions.explanation: 修饰可数名词复数短语 other things 用 many，表示“许多其他事情做”；而 a lot 需与 of 连用（a lot of），故选 many。

questions.prompt: 4. 选出空白处④的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 你可以加入不同的俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 加入俱乐部或组织用动词 join，故选 join。

questions.prompt: 5. 选出空白处⑤的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 如果你擅长游泳，你就可以在游泳俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“you can be at the swimming club”可知，擅长的是游泳，故选 swimming。

questions.prompt: 6. 选出空白处⑥的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 也许你弹钢琴或打鼓弹得不是很好。
questions.explanation: 在否定句中并列成分通常用 or 连接，故选 or。

questions.prompt: 7. 选出空白处⑦的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 但你可以在音乐俱乐部学习弹奏它们。
questions.explanation: “学习做某事”用 learn to do sth.，故选 learn。

questions.prompt: 8. 选出空白处⑧的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 我喜欢书，并且我经常去读书俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“reading club”可知，喜欢的是书，故选 books。

questions.prompt: 9. 选出空白处⑨的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 我的朋友画画画得很好，她一周去两次美术俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“goes to the art club”以及“Do you like painting?”可知，擅长画画，故选 draw。

questions.prompt: 10. 选出空白处⑩的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 你可以向她学习。
questions.explanation: “向某人学习”用 learn from sb.，故选 from。

sections.title: V. 阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Most of you may find that it is easy to make friends at school. Because when you are at school, people around you are at the same age and have the same interest. After leaving school, you may meet more people, but few of them may become your friends. What can you do to make new friends? Here are some suggestions.

- **Be more active (积极的).**
Don't stay there and wait for others to come to you. Do something to give yourself and others a chance to know more about one another.
- **Join a club.**
That's a great way for you to meet more people with the same interest. It must be easy for you to talk with them.
- **Don't be shy.**
Try not to be shy when you meet people for the first time. Shyness may make you lose a friend.
- **Be ready to help.**
<u>A friend in need is a friend indeed.</u> Help your friend if he/she really needs your help.

questions.prompt: 1. Where can people make friends more easily according to this passage?
questions.translation: 根据这篇文章，人们在哪里更容易交朋友？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Most of you may find that it is easy to make friends at school.”可知，在学校交朋友最容易，故选 At school。

questions.prompt: 2. How many suggestions does the writer give you on making friends?
questions.translation: 作者给出了多少条关于交朋友的建议？
questions.explanation: 文章中列出了四条加粗的建议（Be more active, Join a club, Don't be shy, Be ready to help），故选 4。

questions.prompt: 3. The underlined sentence means "________".
questions.explanation: “A friend in need is a friend indeed.” 的中文意思是“患难见真情”，故选 患难见真情。

questions.prompt: 4. What should you do to make friends after you leave school?
options: Wait for new colleagues to come to you.
Stay in your house and surf the Internet.
Run away when others need help.
questions.translation: 离开学校后，为了交朋友你应该做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文中第一条建议“Be more active. Don't stay there and wait for others to come to you.”可知，要主动去结交他人。选项“Talk actively with new neighbours.”（主动与新邻居交谈）符合积极主动结交新朋友的原则，故选 Talk actively with new neighbours.。'Wait for new colleagues to come to you.' 与文章建议相反。

sections.title: V. 阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 下面是五个同学的兴趣爱好，方框中是六条俱乐部的招新广告，请为每位同学选择一个合适的俱乐部。
wordbank: A. Come and join Ball Game Club! We have soccer, volleyball and ping-pong for you. Sunday: 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.; 3:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m.
B. Do you like skating? You can find many friends with the same interest here. Saturday and Sunday: 8:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.
C. Welcome to Bike Riding Club! Why not go out with us by bike? Saturday: 6:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.
D. What do you think of Chinese kung fu? If you think it's fantastic, join us! Sunday: 5:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.
E. Stories! Stories! Stories! Miss White will help you read stories. Monday and Thursday: 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m.
F. Run with us. Feel the wind and build your body! Saturday and Sunday: 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 a.m.

questions.prompt: 5. Linda wants to learn Chinese kung fu. She is free on Sunday morning.
questions.translation: 琳达想学中国功夫，她周日上午有空。
questions.explanation: D选项提到了中国功夫（Chinese kung fu），活动时间是周日（Sunday: 5:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.），完全符合琳达的需求与时间，故选 D选项。

questions.prompt: 6. Judy likes riding a bike. She wants to make friends with bike riding lovers.
questions.translation: 朱迪喜欢骑自行车，她想和骑行爱好者交朋友。
questions.explanation: C选项是自行车骑行俱乐部（Bike Riding Club），符合朱迪的爱好，故选 C。

questions.prompt: 7. Sam loves soccer very much. He wants to play ball games with friends on Sundays.
questions.translation: 萨姆非常喜欢足球，他想在周日和朋友们一起玩球类游戏。
questions.explanation: A选项是球类运动俱乐部（Ball Game Club），包含足球且在周日活动，符合萨姆的需求，故选 A。

questions.prompt: 8. John loves to run. He'd like to run with some friends on the weekend.
questions.translation: 约翰喜欢跑步，他想在周末和一些朋友一起跑步。
questions.explanation: 约翰喜欢跑步（John loves to run），想在周末（on the weekend）和朋友跑步，F选项是跑步俱乐部（Run with us），时间为周末周六周日（Saturday and Sunday: 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 a.m.），故选 F选项。

questions.prompt: 9. Lily likes reading interesting stories. She wants to read more new ones.
questions.translation: 莉莉喜欢读有趣的故事，她想读更多的新故事。
questions.explanation: E选项是讲故事俱乐部（Stories! Stories! Stories!），符合莉莉读故事的需求，故选 E。

sections.title: VI. (2025·成都) 完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Living in a new country is not easy, but not for me. My [1] in China are not only about learning but also about kindness.

I moved from the UK to China and began to teach in a university. Many [2], like visits to museums and food festivals, were organized for international students and teachers to get used to the new [3]. Through them, I made many new Chinese friends and learned more about their language and culture. Gradually, I [4] the university and the city I work in.

Everyone around me is [5]. They showed me how to use a new app, took time to go to the bank with me and helped me enter the school with QR code. One day, my family and I went out shopping. When we [6] to our apartment, we couldn't enter it because the electronic lock did not work. [7] the manager of the building came with the master key. He tried his best but [8]. He called a maintenance staff (维修工) to help and stayed with us [9] the door was opened.

The care I have [10] makes me feel at home. Thanks to everyone around me, my life in a new environment is less hard.

questions.prompt: 1. 选出空白处①的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 我在中国的经历不仅关于学习，也关于善良。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文可知，这是作者在中国的亲身经历，experience意为“经历”，故选 experiences。

questions.prompt: 2. 选出空白处②的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 许多活动，比如参观博物馆和美食节，被组织起来……
questions.explanation: 参观博物馆和美食节属于各种活动（events），故选 events。

questions.prompt: 3. 选出空白处③的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 为了让国际师生习惯新的环境。
questions.explanation: 来到新国家是为了适应新环境（environment），故选 environment。

questions.prompt: 4. 选出空白处④的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 渐渐地，我融入了我工作的大学和城市。
questions.explanation: “融入”用 fit into，故选 fitted into。

questions.prompt: 5. 选出空白处⑤的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 我周围的每个人都很热情（热心）。
questions.explanation: 根据下文他们热心帮助作者的种种事迹可知，大家都很热心（warm），故选 warm。

questions.prompt: 6. 选出空白处⑥的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 当我们返回我们的公寓时……
questions.explanation: 外出购物后“返回”公寓用 return 或 go back，return符合语境，故选 returned。

questions.prompt: 7. 选出空白处⑦的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 不久，大楼经理带着总钥匙来了。
questions.explanation: 锁坏了进不去，随后（Soon）经理就带着钥匙来了，故选 Soon。

questions.prompt: 8. 选出空白处⑧的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 他尽力了但是失败了（没能打开）。
questions.explanation: 由后文他打电话叫维修工可知，他尝试了但没成功（failed），故选 failed。

questions.prompt: 9. 选出空白处⑨的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 并和我们待在一起直到门被打开。
questions.explanation: “直到……为止”用 until，故选 until。

questions.prompt: 10. 选出空白处⑩的最佳选项：
questions.translation: 我所收到的关心让我感到宾至如归。
questions.explanation: 关心是被“收到（received）”的，故选 received。
